annotations.title: Build an app from a design

description: Needs a subscription. Turns an App Builder design into a working Expo app: navigation, providers, tab bar, screens and the components they use. Returns a recipe for the current project: every file with its target path, one install line and ordered steps with a check each. Pass `step` for one step in full, which does not count against the daily allowance.

appId.description: the share code from the App Builder's "Send app to agent", e.g. "34ca4babb2"

override.description: emit even with screens flagged not ready; ask the customer first

page.description: for step write or review; each page names the next

step.description: a step id from the recipe, or "review" for the screen list

name: emit_app
title: Build an app from a design
